gloss: to get out of the way, to step aside

definitions.gloss: to step aside, to move out of the way
definitions.explanation: To move from one's current position to make room.
To leave a position or place.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{退|ど}いて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please step aside for a moment.
To get out of the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{退|ど}く。
⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{退|ど}いて。
⟦{役職|やくしょく}→役職：05514_yakushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{退|ど}く。
⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{退|ど}いてくれ。
examples.english: You're in the way, so move.

examples.english: Move a bit so I can take a photo.

examples.english: I stepped down from my long-held position as committee chair and decided to leave it to my successor.

notes:
{退|ど}く is a godan verb meaning to move out of the way or step aside.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- No transitive pair with same reading

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral. Common in everyday speech for asking people to move.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {道|みち}を{退|ど}く: to get out of the way
- そこを{退|ど}く: to move from there
- {座|ざ}を{退|ど}く: to step down from a position

IMPERATIVE FORMS:
- {退|ど}け！: Move! (rough command)
- {退|ど}いて！: Please move! (te-form request)
- {退|ど}いてください: Please step aside (polite)

ALTERNATE READING:
- {退|しりぞ}く: to retreat, withdraw (more formal/literary)

SIMILAR:
- どける (transitive): to move something out of the way
